title: Ground state solutions for Hartree type equations driven by superposition operators and Pohozaev Identity
summary: We investigate Hartree-type equations driven by a nonlocal operator $\mathcal{L}_μ$, defined as a superposition of fractional Laplacians through a signed Borel measure $μ$. Under Berestycki-Lions type assumptions, we prove the existence of a Mountain Pass solution and show that its energy level coincides with the minimum on the Pohozaev manifold. We also establish the boundedness of non-negative solutions.
